assertion: XML whitespace inherits through SVG groups, preserves spaces and converts newlines in preserve mode, and removes newlines and collapses spaces in default mode.

browser.reason: The reference encodes the specification-derived character sequences with NBSP because browsers disagree on xml:space. It preserves one glyph advance for each expected space. Unit tests separately verify default-mode newline removal, preservation, inheritance and CSS precedence. Reviewed native differences are confined to glyph edges (1058 pixels, maximum channel delta 143); character positions and solid regions agree.
